caseName: Markle Interests, L.L.C. v. U.S. Fish & Wildlife Serv.
caseNameFull: MARKLE INTERESTS, L.L.C. v. UNITED STATES FISH AND WILDLIFE SERVICE

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit. Petition for writ of certiorari granted. Judgment vacated, and case remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit for further consideration in light of Weyerhaeuser Co. v. United States Fish and Wildlife Serv., et al., 586 U.S. ----, 139 S.Ct. 361, ---L.Ed.2d ---- (2018).
